breakpoints.note: There is no deeper parser gate on the crashing path. The exact 32768-byte witness reaches the unsafe write because `size > sizeof(copy)` evaluates false at equality, so control falls through to the full-size copy and the terminator store.
First project statement that consumes the attacker-controlled input length and decides whether it is reduced to fit the fixed `copy` buffer.

For the witnessed 32768-byte file, the guard is false and leaves `size` equal to the full array length. The patch fixes this exact off-by-one condition by clamping with `min(sizeof(copy) - 1, size)` before the copy and terminator write.
